name: Classic Vanilla
ingredients_raw: water, sweeteners (blend [maltitol, stevia (steviol glycoside)]), milk solids, inulin, dietary fiber (oligofructose), stabilizers (401, 410, 412), emulsifiers (471, 477), natural food color (beta-carotene), natural flavoring substances (vanilla), chocolate coating (13.5%) [sweetener (maltitol), edible vegetable oil (palm oil, palm kernel oil), cocoa butter, cocoa mass, whole milk powder, emulsifiers (322, 471), natural identical flavoring substance (vanillin)], edible vegetable oil (coconut)
